title: One asset record, version 1
description: One file (or one folder of files, such as frames baked from a clip) that a film is made with: where it came from, its licence, its bytes. A project's assets/ledger.json, a generated clip's own ledger, a sound library outside the repo and a cross-film look ledger are all collections of these records; only where they live differs (tools/assets/ledger.py). Fields not named here are kept as they are (a vendor's terms, a request id, the inputs of a generation).

v.description: the record's version; a new meaning gets a new number

id.description: unique in its collection, never reused (a removed record keeps it)

kind.description: model: a 3D model (glb, gltf, usd, fbx, obj, blend)

path.description: POSIX, relative to the collection's base (a project ledger: the project folder) or absolute; a folder ends with /

sha256.description: of the file's bytes; of a folder, the sha256 of its listing: one line per file, '<relative path>\t<sha256>\n', sorted by path

class.description: tools/assets/licenses.py has what each means and which ones Assets: strict takes

name.description: the licence as the source writes it: CC BY 4.0, Pixabay Content License

by.description: how the class was decided: from the name and URL, or given with the record

origin.description: self: made in the project; user: the user's own material

file_url.description: what was fetched, when it differs from url

provider.description: nasa, wikimedia-commons, openverse, freesound, gemini, fal …

retrieved.description: the date or time it was fetched

range.description: seconds in the original: the part taken

library.description: the library it was picked from (origin library)

attribution.description: the credit line exactly as it must appear; without it bin/vh assets credits builds one from source and license

aigc.description: made by a generative model (an image, a clip, a voice, music): the film has to say so where it is published

model.description: vendor/model, with its version: gemini/gemini-3-pro-image, fal/bytedance/seedance-2.5 (Seedance 2.5)

prompt_file.description: a path, on the same base as path

currency.description: USD, CNY, EUR, or a vendor's credits (TRIPO-CREDITS)

cost.description: what this record cost; the budget adds up assets/spend.jsonl, not these

used_by.description: what it is for, as declared: shot ids, a chapter, cover, bgm, input:<id>

derived_from.description: the id of the record this one was made from (a clip's baked frames, a crop)

removed.description: no longer part of the film: kept on record, left out of check and credits
